notes_for_editor: No build date, design, staffing, fire history or removal date found. The lookout history page for Butternut carries only a name, county and state line. The FFLOS list gives coordinates and status only. Unverified leads not used: a Facebook group post that mentions a fire tower near Butternut (only a search snippet was seen), and a Butternut town history page on sites.rootsweb.com (HTTP 403 on fetch). Story is about 60 words, below the 120-word floor, because the evidence is that thin; the editor may prefer to hold it until a better source turns up.
